scope: Navisworks source objects relevant to S5 coordination, S6 federation/coordinates, and S7 deliverables

sources.title: JSON - Navisworks Export Settings
sources.notes: The five source instructions are represented in the current L6 instruction without inventing unresolved preset values.

sources.title: S5 – Navisworks Project Setup for Coordination
sources.content_role: Navisworks coordination-container setup, provenance, coordinate alignment, governed sets, validation and change control
sources.notes: The current workflow compresses setup actions but does not preserve the source requirements as a distinct governed project-setup object.

sources.title: S5 – Navisworks Clash Detection Matrix – Standard Setup
sources.content_role: clash-matrix profile, test-family, traceability, modification authority and sign-off-readiness governance
sources.notes: Current main contains clash types and execution workflow, but not a matrix/profile registry preserving required metadata and governance.

sources.title: Navisworks Federation & Coordination Standards
sources.content_role: detailed federation and coordinate implementation guidance
sources.notes: Mature principles may support existing governed objects, but exact append toggles, thresholds, folder maps, owners and other TODO content are not promoted.

sources.title: Metadata and Export Settings for Navisworks
sources.content_role: human-readable export guidance and proposed export profiles
sources.notes: The page explicitly points to JSON - Navisworks Export Settings as the governed values source. Proposed profiles and unresolved exact settings remain draft evidence.

sources.title: ACC Model Coordination vs Navisworks – Clash & Issue Workflows
sources.content_role: ACC/Navisworks hybrid routing and system-of-record recommendation
sources.notes: Current main already preserves the boundary that Navisworks is technical coordination and formal issue/acceptance evidence must remain in the governed system of record. The retired source organization identifier is preserved only in Confluence provenance, not repeated in canonical machine-readable content. Draft tool-preference recommendations are not newly elevated.

sources.title: Metadata and Deliverables Standards for Navisworks
sources.content_role: Navisworks deliverable classification, storage, records and handover guidance
sources.notes: The source leaves key deliverable criteria, storage paths, retention, record status and traceability details unresolved. No draft folder examples are promoted as enterprise rules.

sources.title: Gaps in Navisworks
sources.notes: Used to reconcile whether historical gaps were subsequently addressed; it is not itself normative.

rules: Source DRAFT or TODO content is not promoted as final authority.
Existing current-main objects are enriched or referenced rather than duplicated.
Numeric tolerances, exact clash pairs, folder paths, exporter toggles and owner roles are not invented when the source leaves them unresolved.
